raw.details:
Overview:

NYPO 2026 – National Young Programmers Olympiad is a national-level technology competition for students from Classes 8 to 12 across India, organised by Polaris School of Technology and Navneet Education. It is designed to test students on logic, problem-solving, creativity and their ability to build with technology and AI. No prior coding knowledge is required to participate.

The Olympiad has two tracks:

  • Junior Track: Classes 8–10
  • Senior Track: Classes 11–12

Students progress through three stages:

  • Coding Aptitude – Logical thinking and problem-solving
  • Video Round – Demonstrate and communicate their approach to an idea
  • Vibecoding – Use code and AI tools to turn ideas into something real

Registered students will receive preparation material, and the difficulty level is designed separately for each track.

Participants can compete for opportunities and rewards including:

  • Amazon HQ Bengaluru Visit + Industry Exposure & Mentorship
  • ₹10 Lakh Cash Prize
  • ₹1 Crore Polaris Scholarship Grant
  • MacBook Air
  • $100K worth of Tech Credits
  • National-level Certificates & Recognition

Other Details

  • Registration Fee: ₹499
  • Eligibility: Classes 8–12
  • Last Date for Phase 1 Registration: 30 September 2026
